family: F=AND_minus(g,y)=(1+g+y-g*y)/2, arbitrary Boolean core on uniform physical bits and one DISTINCT fresh balanced physical bit; arbitrary iterated fresh guards

outcome_rule: Prove the unique maximum analytically, bound it by exact root endpoints, and record any unresolved sign. Upper candidates are frozen; do not call the scalar threshold the optimal full-hull-contraction rate. Full FEI remains OPEN and arbitrary initial inner pricing is not assumed.
